## Natural history notes

A large hawk characterized by its broad rounded wings, stocky body, pale underparts with a darker belly band, and reddish-brown tail in adults. In Florida, it is found in open and semi-open habitats, including pine flatwoods, pastures, fields, prairies, agricultural areas, roadsides, forest edges, and suburban areas with tall trees or poles for perching and nesting. It feeds mainly on small mammals, reptiles, birds, and other small animals, usually hunting from an exposed perch or soaring overhead before dropping down onto prey.
